# `redundant-import-path`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports a relative import path beginning with an unnecessary `./` segment.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Canonical spelling makes duplicate paths easier to recognize and keeps imports
consistent.

## When it fires

It applies to local string-literal imports where removing `./` preserves
resolution.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const util = @import("./util.zig");
```
